Providers list matches (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, Cerebras, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, custom OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible). Hyper pricing exactly matches record: free 100 Hypercredits/month, $20/month with 250 daily refreshing credits, bundles $5=100 / $10=500 / $20=2,000, 1 Hypercredit = 5 cents. Hyper privacy: 'Your prompts and outputs are never used to train AI models. Period.', default no retention with 'up to 30 days if temporarily retained' for debugging/abuse/legal, 'A Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is available upon request by contacting legal@charm.land', SCCs for transfers, and no SOC 2 / ISO 27001 / HIPAA mentioned - all as recorded. Hyper homepage now markets 'zero data retention'; the privacy policy's up-to-30-day debug carve-out means the record's conservative note should stand as written. NOT checked: crush releases page (record pins no version).
